blocks.text: You are on www.kindlingco.example, the shop you opened.
The form at Kindling Co wants plastic digits, the month and year, and the short code on the back. It does not ask for a bank site secret.
Fragile glass leaves the stockroom in a double mailer.
Lane cushion, eight dollars and twenty eight cents, was printed under the tag before you added Beech cutting board.
The amount due includes that printed amount and matches the earlier quote.
Linen sleeve at $12.02 is not ticked and is outside the amount due.
Last week's tag was seventy four dollars and forty nine cents. Today's item figure $59.34 is the real drop, and it will not rise later.
